name: Return to Verner
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ok, I'll give him his 50 horseshoes...

Here they are, all boxed up and ready to go!  Tell Verner it was a pleasure doing business, and be sure he reads the note attached to this crate!
narrative.objectives: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge.  Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, this really helps me out.

But what's this? Argus sent a note with the crate...What?? Argus wants me to PAY him? Bah!

Well, adventurer, thank you for your help.
narrative.requestItemsText: Great, you're back! Did you get the shoes?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 18 to 25, 5,865 XP in all.

quests.name: The Price of Shoes
quests.objectiveText: Take Verner's Note to Smith Argus in Goldshire.

quests.name: Return to Verner
quests.objectiveText: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

quests.name: Underbelly Scales
quests.objectiveText: Gather 6 Underbelly Whelp Scales from Black Dragon Whelps, and bring them to Verner Osgood in Redridge.

quests.name: A Baying of Gnolls
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Redridge Brutes and 8 Redridge Mystics, then return to Verner Osgood.

quests.name: Howling in the Hills
quests.objectiveText: Bring Yowler's Paw to Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.
